feasibility.stoneSettingMethod: Kundan foil setting with lac (resin) backing
suggestedChanges: Reduce the number of hanging pearl drops from 5 to 3 to cut assembly time
Widen the dome base by 1-2mm so the kundan stones seat more securely
Use a single-piece cast base instead of soldered chain links to reduce labour

suggestedSimplifications: Merge the two thinnest inner curves into one bolder line so the wood block doesn't chip during carving
Increase the gap between the small dot accents by at least 3mm for cleaner hand-stamping
Keep the outline as the single 'rekh' block and use one 'datta' block for the fill colour
